CREATE TABLE "public"."audit_logs" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actor_user_id" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "ip_address" text,
  "metadata" json,
  "sign_request_id" "uuid",
  "user_agent" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "audit_logs_action_check_d56752b7" CHECK ("action" IN ('SIGN_REQUEST_CREATED', 'DOCUMENT_CREATED', 'DOCUMENT_OPENED', 'PLACEMENT_CREATED', 'PLACEMENT_UPDATED', 'SIGN_ATTEMPT', 'PIN_FAILED', 'SIGNED', 'REJECTED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."documents" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "file_key" text NOT NULL,
  "file_size" int4,
  "hash" text,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "locked" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "mime_type" text,
  "sign_request_id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "documents_type_check_b4fd3c0b" CHECK ("type" IN ('ORIGINAL', 'SIGNED', 'ATTACHMENT'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sign_requests" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "reference_id" text NOT NULL,
  "rejected_at" timestamptz,
  "rejection_reason" text,
  "signed_at" timestamptz,
  "signer_user_id" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "village_id" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "sign_requests_status_check_14769a7d" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'SIGNED', 'REJECTED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."signature_placements" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "document_id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "height" float8 NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "page" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sequence" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "sign_request_id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "signer_user_id" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text DEFAULT 'SIGNATURE' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "width" float8 NOT NULL,
  "x" float8 NOT NULL,
  "y" float8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "signature_placements_type_check_577a5452" CHECK ("type" IN ('SIGNATURE', 'INITIAL', 'STAMP', 'QR_CODE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."signatures" (
  "algorithm" text NOT NULL,
  "certificate_issuer" text,
  "certificate_serial" text,
  "document_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "document_id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "sign_request_id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "signature_value" text NOT NULL,
  "signed_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "signer_user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."signer_credentials" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "failed_attempt" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "locked_until" timestamptz,
  "pin_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
